europe_now.title: Zelensky Responds to US Criticism Over Energy Strikes
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky defended his country's right to self-defense following criticism from US President Donald Trump regarding recent energy strikes. Meanwhile, European leaders at a summit in Brussels reaffirmed their continued support for Ukraine amid rising international tensions.

sources.headline: Zelensky says Ukraine has right to defend itself after Trump calls latest strikes a 'disgrace'

europe_now.title: European Migration Policy Debates at EU Summit
europe_now.summary: Denmark has asked the European Union to examine Spain's recent plan to legalize undocumented migrants. Additionally, leaders from nations including Denmark, Italy, and Poland are pushing the bloc to adopt a much tougher stance on irregular migration and border controls.

sources.headline: Denmark asks EU to ‘examine’ Spain’s plan to legalize migrants
Denmark, Italy, Poland urge EU leaders to harden stance on irregular migration

top_stories.title: Franco-German Industrial Policy
top_stories.summary: France and Germany are pushing for their own specific automotive and industrial rules outside of standard European Union legislation. This bilateral push aims to establish unique regulatory frameworks for key sectors within the bloc.

sources.headline: Germany and France want own ‘Made in Europe’ rules for cars, outside EU industrial policy
